top_signal.title: Finding CPA
top_signal.summary: We're looking for a reliable CPA for our business taxes and I'm not sure where to find legitimate help. We're on our second tax preparer and they're unreliable- both of our preparers are local businesses that we found through word of mouth. Is there a legitimate online database we can go through or are tax preparers notoriously unreliable/ uncommunicative? The first one just kept filing extensions and the second one can't even get into QB accountant view, and now they're asking for the personal log-in.   And how do I check an accountants license?       submitted by     /u/Any_Dirt2073       [link]       [comments]
